words: An inactive player, grouped by days since their last deposit: 1D, 3D, 7D, 14D or 30D.
A responsible-gaming or loss-chasing flag on the player. It beats every push: no push at all, route to welfare.
A bonus on the player's next deposit, with a validity period and 1x turnover.
The total valid bet amount. 1x means the player must bet the bonus once before withdrawing.
The upload file types. TC takes .txt, Zyra takes .csv exported from the BO. The wrong type fails the upload.
The backend system where you check and update player details.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Can you push this player?
items: No RG / chase flag on the player
The player is inactive (on today's 1D to 30D list)
No similar bonus claimed this cycle
tour.done: All three: pick the tier and send.
tour.notYet: An RG / chase flag means no push at all: route to welfare.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Five steps, in this order
items: Check the flag
RG / chase flag: stop, route to welfare.
Pick the tier
1D Push only. 3D and above: SMS + Internal Message.
Export
TC: save as .txt. Zyra: export .csv from the BO.
Send approved copy
Template Tab, Risk Player. Do not change the copy without TL approval. Say: next deposit, validity, 1x turnover.
QA Record
Attach a BO screenshot. Tag Risk 1D to 30D, then Reactivated on deposit.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Push a player with an RG / chase flag.
Upload the wrong file type (TC .txt, Zyra .csv).
Change the approved copy without TL approval.
Send the SMS yourself. Retention Admin sends it; you prepare the list.

tour.label: Tiers
tour.title: What each tier gets
items: 1D, soft reminder
Push only. Light, no urgency, no SMS, no IM.
3D, soft emotional pull
SMS + Internal Message. Personal, emotional appeal. No bonus.
7D, strong incentive
SMS + Internal Message. Reload bonus, 1x turnover, limited time. [CONFIRM] Is it 10%?
14D, strong incentive
As 7D, higher bonus. [CONFIRM] Is it 15%, or at TL discretion?
30D, strong incentive
As 7D, the highest reactivation push. [CONFIRM] Is it 20%?

tour.label: Claim
tour.title: How does the player get the reload?
tour.q: Is the player on a TC brand?
tour.yes: TC: the bonus is automatic. The player claims it directly in the app or website.
tour.no: Zyra: manual. The player contacts Live Chat, you state the offer for the next deposit. Already deposited? Credit it by Lark ticket.

pool.q: A 7D player has an RG / chase flag. What do you send?
pool.why: The RG / chase flag beats every push. No push at all; route the player to welfare.

pool.q: Which channel does a 1D player get?
pool.why: 1D is a soft reminder: Push only, no urgency, no SMS, no IM.

pool.q: Which channels does a 3D player get?
pool.why: 3D and above: SMS + Internal Message. 3D is the soft emotional pull.

pool.q: You are uploading the Zyra risk list. Which file type?
pool.why: TC takes .txt, Zyra takes .csv exported from the BO. The wrong type fails the upload.

pool.q: You think the push copy could be better. Can you change it?
pool.why: Use the approved copy from Template Tab, Risk Player. Do not change it without TL approval.

pool.q: A Zyra 7D player already deposited before contacting you. How do they get the reload?
o: Credit it manually by Lark ticket
pool.why: Zyra is manual. If the player already deposited, credit it manually via a Lark ticket.

pool.q: What must the 7D message say clearly?
pool.why: Communication control: the bonus applies to the next deposit, has a validity period and needs 1x turnover.

pool.q: Who sends the SMS to 3D players?
pool.why: SMS is sent by Retention Team Admin. VIP CS prepares the list only.
